verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a programmatic SDK with no UI requirement, so it is headless by design. Code calls getSandbox(), exec() (capturing stdout, stderr and exit codes), file APIs, streaming output, and per-session command timeouts. The docs explicitly name CI/CD systems and Git automation as target use cases. missing for 10: documentation for invoking it from an external CI pipeline (e.g. a CLI or CI-runner integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
